study.title: Local FluidLab zero-action and small-tilt development checks

context.description: Seed 0; 40,604 particles; 64^3 grid; config initial pose; 100 steps at control 0 or 0.00115. Not SI calibrated, not a held-out benchmark, not verified as paper-result replication. Raw loss and height-threshold proxies remain in runtime artifacts; no pouring-success claim.

evidence.exact_quote:
Local native-unit FluidLab CPU validation, not a paper reproduction or physical experiment.
zero: control_wz=0.0; 100 forward steps; 40604 active particles at final state; nominal horizon 0.2000 code time units (steps * dt * substeps); initial active mass 1.85870361328125, final active mass 1.85870361328125, active mass fraction 1 (final / initial); finite states at every tested step.
tilt: control_wz=0.00115; 100 forward steps; 40604 active particles at final state; nominal horizon 0.2000 code time units (steps * dt * substeps); initial active mass 1.85870361328125, final active mass 1.85870361328125, active mass fraction 1 (final / initial); finite states at every tested step.
Gradient gate: PASS. Optimization: completed_bounded_pilot.

study.transcription_method: Deterministic extraction from local report; duration is steps*dt*substeps and mass fraction is final ledger/initial ledger. Raw report hash retained.
